purpose: Teach: 杉山/土井/松尾/大石/杉浦/小坂/田原/赤松

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の杉山さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard one of your regular customers was having tea with their friend Sugiyama the other day.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Soft opening—Mei is sharing something she noticed. Warm, not probing. Slight lift at the end, inviting Aoi to respond if she wants to.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、土井家のお茶会に出られるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, you mean that customer who's been invited to the Doi family tea ceremony?
lines.style: Bright recognition. Aoi's catching on to who Mei means. Quick, engaged response—she's placing the customer. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、松尾芭蕉の旧居を訪ねられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yes—the one who visited Matsuo Bashō's old house that time.
lines.style: Confirming nod in the voice. Warm and almost conspiratorial, like they're building the picture together. Relaxed pace, gentle emphasis on Bashō.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、忠臣蔵の大石内蔵助のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's them. They're a huge fan of the Forty-Seven Ronin story—obsessed with Ōishi Kuranosuke.
lines.style: Low, knowing tone. Aoi's adding the detail with understated amusement. Not mocking—more like they're both in on the joke of knowing their regulars so well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の杉浦さんとよく来店されるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Exactly. And they come in pretty regularly with their friend Sugiura, don't they?
lines.style: Confirmation wrapped in warmth. Mei's voice settles into shared knowledge. Slight trailing rise on the question—checking if Aoi remembers too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お母様のお名前が小坂さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh right—I think their mother's name is Kosaka, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful recall. Aoi's retrieving a detail from the back of her mind. Gentle, not forced. The tone of remembering someone's story because it mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、田原俊彦の歌をカラオケで歌ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yes. And apparently they were singing Toshihiko Tahara songs at karaoke the other night.
lines.style: Soft amusement underneath. Mei's sharing this small, human detail with affection. Slight warmth on the image of them at karaoke. Natural, conversational cadence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、赤松林を散策してから来店されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That sounds about right. They stopped by after taking a walk through the Akamatsu forest earlier that day, I think.
lines.style: Gentle, piecing-it-together tone. Aoi's relaxed, remembering. Soft close—she's content with the quiet knowledge of her customers' lives. No rush in the delivery.
